risk_if_not_implemented: Without Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM), counterfeit, non-conforming or compromised components and services may enter the environment through the supply chain. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), Uncontrolled Third-Party Security / Privacy Exposure (R-GV-5), Long-Term Confidentiality Loss from Cryptographic Obsolescence (R-IP-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12), Harvest Now / Decrypt Later (HNDL) (MT-28), Cryptographic Compromise / Cryptanalytic Capability Advancement (MT-31).

compensating_control_1.name: Asset Inventories
compensating_control_1.justification: Asset Inventories (AST-04) provides asset and inventory visibility that compensates for the absence of Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM) (TDA-21.1) by providing the foundational asset knowledge needed to manage risks associated with the primary control. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Configuration Management Program
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of configuration management controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Configuration Management Program (CFG-02) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM) (TDA-21.1) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
